newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae CEO Lawrence Hough to resign.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae CEO Lawrence Hough to resign.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Wednesday that its chief executive, Lawrence Hough, will resign after shareholders vote in July on a plan to reorganize and privatise the company.
The management of Sallie Mae -- as the company is commonly called -- is at odds with dissident shareholders over control of the company.
Sallie Mae also proposed the election of current board member and First Chicago Vice Chairman David Vitale as chairman.

Both Hough's resignation and Vitale's election are part of a restructuring plan by Sallie Mae's current management that includes giving the dissident shareholders group -- known as the Committee to Restore Value -- five of 15 board seats.
